t: I'm really looking forward to Keira's party tonight.
Have you heard what she's got planned?
Yeah, I heard there's going to be live music by some university music students—some friends of hers have a band and agreed to play there.
Also, she asked me to bring some games, but I don't think I have any.
Well, trivia contests are always fun.
And it's easy to find those online.
I didn't want to disappoint Keira.
